commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
echo "ado_browse(\"code = 'Pub_CDW_BOND_EUCLOSE'\");" | ac_evalform - | ac_trigger_ado.sh -
if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/cdw/out ac_extract.sh -c Pub_CDW_BOND_EUCLOSE -t 160000 -i
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/ipv/out ac_blend_extract.sh -t 160000 -i -k 7 Pub_IPV_BOND_EUCLOSE,Pub_IPV_BOND_EUCLOSE_ORIG,Pub_IPV_BOND_EUCLOSE_PREV
else
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/cdw/out ac_extract.sh -d $BusinessDate -c Pub_CDW_BOND_EUCLOSE -t 160000 -i
  AC_REPDIR=/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/ipv/out ac_blend_extract.sh -d $BusinessDate -t 160000 -i -k 7 Pub_IPV_BOND_EUCLOSE,Pub_IPV_BOND_EUCLOSE_ORIG,Pub_IPV_BOND_EUCLOSE_PREV
fi
